summary: Nora picks up the recurring ways your group interacts with each other, not just the words you use.
details: Plan 2 of the Dreamer: alongside the room's own slang, she now notices recurring exchange patterns — two or more people trading insults, banter, teasing, a running callback joke, and the like.

She only ever classifies WHAT kind of exchange it is, from a fixed, small list — never what was actually said, and never a claim about any one person. Nothing she stores or renders can describe fewer than two people.
Rendered into her live context the same way the room's own words are, with a real quote under each pattern and a note that it describes an interaction, not a person.
limitations: Ships turned off, gated by the same switch as the room-language glossary. It is not live in any room yet.

The classification vocabulary is a small, fixed set (insult trades, banter, teasing, callback jokes, agreement/disagreement rituals, compliment exchanges) — an interaction that does not fit one of these is simply not noticed yet.
